claims.claim_quote: مینای سطح لبیال ثنایای پایین از ثنایای بالا نازک‌تر است؛ این تفاوت به‌خصوص در ناحیه سرویکال بیشتر دیده می‌شود [4].
claims.note: Two halves, both silent in the abstract (F3 step 2). Half 1, 'mandibular thinner than maxillary', is a comparative (F2 item 3). The abstract states only that the thickness 'was significantly different between the maxillary and mandibular incisors' and gives per-tooth ranges (MdIs 0.343 to 0.792 mm; MxCIs 0.461 to 0.966 mm; MxLIs 0.346 to 0.984 mm). No sentence ranks the two jaws, so the direction is silence. Half 2, 'the difference is greatest at the cervical region', claims that the between-jaw difference varies by region (F2-iv). The only regional finding ('In all incisors, the enamel was thickest in the incisal region and significantly thinner in the cervical region') is about region within every incisor and does not name the between-jaw difference, so this half is also silence. Read: Statement of problem, Purpose, Material and methods, Results, Conclusions.

source_conclusion: Vertically, the labial enamel thickness increased from the cervical region to the incisal region in all incisors.
fact_fa: از ۰ ادعایی که منبع به آن پرداخته‌اند، ۰ مورد مطابق است، ۰ مورد تغییر یافته و ۰ مورد برعکس؛ سطح انطباق ادعای کافی ندارد.
interpretation_fa: هر ادعای قابل‌بررسی با منبع مطابق است.
